zh: 多用户与权限管控增强：完善多账号租户隔离、团队沙箱边界与权限校验机制。
需求管理与意见反馈升级：重构图片附件上传体验，支持增量上传、拖拽与截图粘贴，并支持多图优雅大图预览及单独删除；提交成功后自动平滑关闭弹窗。
导航栏与菜单布局优化：优化「更多」抽屉菜单结构，将友情链接合理收拢至菜单底部与自定义菜单栏上方。
en: Multi-user and access control: enhanced tenant isolation, team sandbox boundaries, and permission verification.
Requirement plaza and feedback: overhauled image attachments with incremental uploads, drag-and-drop, screenshot paste, full-screen lightbox preview, and auto-closing dialogs.
Sidebar navigation layout: refined the More drawer menu, placing friend links neatly above the custom menu at the bottom of the list.
